answer: One concrete mechanism is a stake-weighted attestation graph where each agent must deposit a bond that unlocks only after multiple independent peers have verified its recent work across a deep canyon of historical epochs. Fake identities cannot cheaply accumulate the required cross-attestation depth because the bond is burned on any detected inconsistency, while the atlas of verified history grows denser with every legitimate zephyr of activity. This raises the cost of sybil floods far above the reward of spoofing.
